description: Compiler warnings of the selected engine units (clang -fsyntax-only with the build's own flags), counted per file and kind. tests.codegen.test_engine_warnings fails on a new kind, a higher count or a stale entry. Dispositions: dead_under_profile (code the profile cannot reach), harmless, revisit (upstream defect to re-check when the feature arrives).

warnings.note: PERIOD_MAX (ULONG_MAX) is stored into an int period sentinel: -1 and -2 on this LP64 host, identical to the 32-bit long of the Windows build; compared back as unsigned long it recovers the sentinel. Reproduced by test_period_max_narrowing_is_the_same_as_a_32_bit_long.
Literal `if (0 || 1) return 1;` left by upstream in a helper that always succeeds.
NULL passed as an address constant (zero) to a debug-hook parameter of type uaecptr.
Copper state-transition switches (on the previous state) list only the states that need special handling and have no default arm; unlisted states take no special action. Upstream style.
Debug log line tests an array member against NULL (always true); only chooses between the label and a placeholder.
Two log lines pass evt_t / a 64-bit size to %lu / %d; they only affect debug text on LP64. Not adapted to keep the file's delta small.

drive_image_free, drive_write_data and the revolution handler switch on the image type and list only the types that need action (IPF, SCP, FDI, ADF variants, FloppyBridge); there is no default arm, so the rest do nothing.
The line-doubling switch lists the black/doubled/normal-black cases it handles and has no default arm; unlisted modes take no action there.
Genlock colour-key test compares an unsigned char with 256, always true; the mask lookup below it is unchanged.
A failure log line passes an unused argument; text only.
bank->start = NULL assigns zero to an address field.

The autoconfig_bytes/autoconfig_raw arrays of struct autoconfig_info are tested as pointers, so the else-if that reaches autoconfig_raw is unreachable upstream. Irrelevant while no card uses raw autoconfig (the A500 profile has none); re-evaluate when Fast RAM or cards arrive in M2.
`if (dst[i].custom)` tests the address of an array member, always true, in the port-copy code; the copied custom strings are always empty in the profile (patch 0048). Upstream bug candidate.

Two of the formats (line 6003) are in the debug output of a host file lock and two (lines 10351 and 10396) in the log of the shell execution code: log text for host directories and host shell commands, which a session cannot have (the units are refused unless they are hard files). A wrong width in a log line, never reached.
filesys_createvolname tests a local array as a condition (line 817): it names the volume of a host directory, which the profile refuses before the machine exists.
A comma expression with an unused left operand (line 2245) in the lock code of a virtual volume; the value is the right operand, as intended upstream.
A size_t printed with %d in the debug text of hardware_trap_background (uaeboard > 2), which the profile never selects (trap_is_indirect is false).
Two write_log calls of hardware_trap_thread (uaeboard > 2) miss their argument (a slot number): the thread never starts in the profile, and the line would only print an unspecified number.
